meta.title: unlzx
meta.author: Teo
meta.description: unlzx by Teo, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from modland's V2 collection (`pub/modules/V2/Teo/unlzx.v2m`). 120 BPM, 2:08, 12 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). Teo gave permission (2026-11-09) to publish his music here as adapted versions; the music belongs to him and is removed at his request.
